name: $match
definition: Retains documents that satisfy a condition object.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Field predicates or logical expressions. Use `$expr` for an expression comparison.

behavior: All top-level field predicates must match. An empty condition retains all documents.
`$expr` retains a document only when its expression returns boolean true.
A failed match removes the document from the output list; it does not modify the document.

Supported field predicates: `$eq`, `$ne`, `$gt`, `$gte`, `$lt`, `$lte`, `$in`, `$nin`, `$exists`, `$size`, `$all`, `$elemMatch`, `$regex` (with `$options`), `$type`, `$not`. Logical groups: `$and`, `$or`, `$nor`, `$not`.
limitations: Query predicates and expression operators have different argument shapes. The expression parity suite does not certify query matching.

name: $addFields
definition: Adds or replaces fields while retaining other fields.

parameters.name: field: expression
parameters.description: Destination field path and expression. A dotted path writes a nested object field.

behavior: One output document is returned for each input document.
Direct field expressions read the incoming document. Use a later stage when one assignment depends on a previous assignment.
Nested writes use shallow document copies in this handler. Do not rely on direct Core stage calls to provide SrotaX’s immutable-input authoring guarantees.

name: $set
definition: Adds or replaces fields while retaining other fields.

parameters.name: field: expression
parameters.description: Destination field path and expression. A dotted path writes a nested object field.

behavior: One output document is returned for each input document.
Direct field expressions read the incoming document. Use a later stage when one assignment depends on a previous assignment.
Nested writes use shallow document copies in this handler. Do not rely on direct Core stage calls to provide SrotaX’s immutable-input authoring guarantees.

name: $project
definition: Builds each output document from explicitly selected or computed fields.

parameters.name: field: 1
parameters.description: Copy the named field.

parameters.name: field: 0
parameters.description: Skip this field when building the new document.

parameters.name: field: expression
parameters.description: Compute the destination field. Use `$literal` to assign a literal 0 or 1.

behavior: Only fields explicitly added by the specification appear in the output. `_id` is not included automatically.
A zero entry is skipped; an exclusion-only projection returns an empty object rather than all other fields. Use `$unset` to remove fields while retaining the rest.
The handler recognizes numeric 0/1 flags. Boolean values are computed values, not inclusion/exclusion flags.
limitations: MongoDB supports exclusion projections and includes `_id` by default; this handler does neither.

name: $unset
definition: Removes named fields from each document.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: A field-name string or an array of field-name strings. Dotted paths traverse nested objects.

behavior: Other fields remain in the output. Missing paths are ignored.
The handler copies the top-level object only; nested removal can affect shared nested maps in direct Core calls.

name: $limit
definition: Keeps the first N documents.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Nonnegative numeric count. Use an integer; the handler converts a Number through Java intValue().

behavior: Document order is preserved.
Zero returns an empty list.
Negative values raise an error. A count larger than the list returns the whole list.
limitations: Core accepts zero and truncates fractional numeric counts. Do not infer MongoDB argument validation from this permissive conversion.

name: $skip
definition: Drops the first N documents.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Nonnegative numeric count. Use an integer; the handler converts a Number through Java intValue().

behavior: Document order is preserved.
Zero retains all input documents.
Negative values raise an error. A count larger than the list returns an empty list.
limitations: Core accepts zero and truncates fractional numeric counts. Do not infer MongoDB argument validation from this permissive conversion.

name: $sort
definition: Orders documents by one or more fields.

parameters.name: field: direction
parameters.description: Sort field path and direction: `1` ascending or `-1` descending. Fields are compared in specification order.

behavior: Sorts the document list, not an array inside one document. Use the `$sortArray` expression for an array.
Equal keys keep their incoming order. Missing/null values sort before non-null values in ascending order.
Unsupported comparison values fall back to their string representations. There is no database collation setting.
limitations: The implementation uses Core value comparison and a string fallback, not database collation.

name: $unwind
definition: Produces one document for each element of an array field.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: String field path, normally prefixed with `$`. Only the string form is implemented.

behavior: An empty array, null or missing field emits no document.
A non-null scalar emits the original document once.
Nested field handling uses shallow copies; prefer array expressions for document-local list transformations.
limitations: The object form with `includeArrayIndex` or `preserveNullAndEmptyArrays` is not implemented.

name: $replaceRoot
definition: Replaces the entire document with an object expression.

parameters.name: newRoot
parameters.description: Expression resolving to an object. The object becomes the complete output document.

behavior: The result must be an object. Null, missing or scalar values raise an error.
Other fields from the original document are not retained.

name: $replaceWith
definition: Replaces the entire document with an object expression.

parameters.name: expression
parameters.description: Expression resolving to an object. The object becomes the complete output document.

behavior: The result must be an object. Null, missing or scalar values raise an error.
Other fields from the original document are not retained.

name: $group
definition: Combines documents sharing a grouping key and computes accumulator outputs.

parameters.name: _id
parameters.description: Grouping expression; use null for one group across all documents.

parameters.name: field: accumulator
parameters.description: One accumulator expression per output field, for example `{"$sum":"$amount"}`.

behavior: Produces one output per grouping key; this is a list-level aggregation.
Accumulator operators run in grouping context, separate from expression operators with the same names.
Use a fresh execution context for independent requests; reusing a state store can accumulate groups across calls.
limitations: Expression-operator parity results do not certify grouping accumulators.

name: $sortByCount
definition: Counts documents per grouping value and sorts groups by descending count.

parameters.name: expression
parameters.description: Expression used as the grouping key.

behavior: Internally executes `$group` with a count followed by `$sort` on count descending.
Output fields are `_id` and `count`. Equal-count ordering is not a business ordering guarantee.

name: $bucket
definition: Groups numeric values into explicit lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive ranges.

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Expression resolving to the numeric value to classify.

parameters.name: boundaries
parameters.description: At least two numeric boundaries in ascending order. Adjacent values define ranges.

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: Label for values outside the ranges or for nonnumeric/null/missing values.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Accumulator output fields. Omitted output produces only `_id`; explicitly add count with `$sum: 1`.

behavior: Only populated buckets appear, in boundary order followed by the default bucket.
Without a default, unmatched values are skipped.
Boundary comparison uses doubles. Use a fresh context for independent requests.
limitations: MongoDB errors for unmatched values without a default and supplies a default count when output is omitted. Core skips those values and does not add count automatically.

name: $bucketAuto
definition: Divides the numeric value range into equal-width buckets.

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Numeric expression used to compute the value range. Nonnumeric values are ignored.

parameters.name: buckets
parameters.description: Positive integer number of buckets.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Supported accumulators: `$sum`, `$avg`, `$min`, `$max`, `$push`, `$addToSet`, `$first`, `$last`. No default count is added.

behavior: This implementation uses equal-width ranges, not equal document populations.
Each `_id` is the numeric lower bound. Empty buckets can appear. The final upper bound is maximum + 1.
With no numeric values the output is empty. Granularity is not implemented.
limitations: MongoDB aims for balanced bucket populations and returns `_id.min`/`_id.max`. Core uses equal widths and a scalar `_id`.

name: $facet
definition: Runs named child pipelines over the same input list and collects their results.

parameters.name: name: pipeline
parameters.description: Output field name mapped to an array of stage objects.

behavior: Returns one object with an array for each named branch, including empty branch results.
Each branch receives a top-level copy of each input document. Nested objects are not deeply isolated by this handler.
Unknown branch stages and non-array branch pipelines raise errors.
limitations: No MongoDB memory-size or disk-spill behavior is provided by this in-memory handler.

name: $lookup
definition: Adds matching records from a host-provided in-memory dataset.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Array/object of foreign records, or a dataset name provided in execution globals under `foreignCollections`.

parameters.name: localField
parameters.description: Local join field path.

parameters.name: foreignField
parameters.description: Foreign join field path.

parameters.name: as
parameters.description: Output field containing matched foreign records. Defaults to `results`.

parameters.name: cacheOptions
parameters.description: Cache settings; `maxEntries` defaults to 1024 distinct keys. Size the host dataset accordingly.

behavior: There is no database connection or collection read. The host supplies all records.
No match yields an empty array. Lookup uses key equality in the in-memory index.
An index stops loading after its configured key limit; large datasets can therefore omit matches.
A named dataset must be present even when input is empty.
limitations: Database collection access, correlated lookup pipelines and MongoDB index behavior are not implemented.

name: $densify
definition: Inserts documents for missing numeric or date positions.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Numeric/date field path.

parameters.name: range.step
parameters.description: Positive increment.

parameters.name: range.bounds
parameters.description: `"full"` (default) or `[lower, upper]`.

parameters.name: range.unit
parameters.description: `"millisecond"`, `"second"`, `"minute"`, `"hour"`, or `"day"`.

parameters.name: partitionByFields
parameters.description: Nonempty array of field paths identifying independent partitions.

behavior: Processes gaps within each partition. Generated documents carry the densified field and partition fields.
Null field values are rejected. Keep generation ranges bounded to avoid large allocations.
limitations: The `"partition"` bounds token and larger calendar units are not implemented. No live MongoDB stage parity is claimed.

name: $fill
definition: Replaces null or missing values using a value expression or interpolation.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Exactly one sort field with direction 1 or -1, including for value-based fill.

parameters.name: partitionBy
parameters.description: Expression grouping rows into independent partitions.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Nonempty object mapping destination fields to `{value: expression}` or `{method: name}`.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: `"locf"` carries the last known value; `"linear"` interpolates between numeric endpoints.

behavior: Existing non-null values are preserved. Rows are sorted within each partition.
Linear fill requires surrounding values; leading/trailing gaps without both endpoints remain unfilled.
Use `partitionBy`; a `partitionByFields` option is not implemented in this handler.
limitations: This handler requires single-field sortBy and implements a subset of fill configuration.

name: $setWindowFields
definition: Adds values computed over an ordered partition of documents.

parameters.name: partitionBy
parameters.description: Expression identifying independent partitions.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Exactly one field with numeric direction 1 or -1.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Nonempty object of output fields, each containing one supported window function.

parameters.name: window.documents
parameters.description: Two bounds: integer offsets, `"current"`, or `"unbounded"`. Default is unbounded-to-current.

behavior: Supported functions: `$shift`, `$rank`, `$denseRank`, `$derivative`, `$integral`, `$expMovingAvg`, `$stdDevPop`, `$stdDevSamp`, `$covariancePop`, `$covarianceSamp`.
Only document-position windows are implemented. Range/time windows are rejected.
A function supported as an expression or grouping accumulator is not automatically a supported window function.
limitations: This is a subset of MongoDB window functionality; range windows and other window accumulators are not implemented.

name: $subPipeline
definition: Executes inline child pipelines or resolves child references through the caller’s execution context.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Array of child entries, executed sequentially.

parameters.name: pipeline or ref
parameters.description: Inline stage array or reference resolved by the host. `version` can accompany ref.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Expression selecting child input documents.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Destination for a child result; mapped children must return exactly one document.

parameters.name: when
parameters.description: Boolean expression controlling whether a child runs.

parameters.name: globals
parameters.description: Child global-variable overrides.

parameters.name: onError
parameters.description: `"bubble"`, `"skip"`, or inherited behavior.

parameters.name: parallel / merge
parameters.description: Parallel child array; merge modes `"concat"`, `"zip"`, or `"facet"`.

behavior: A reference requires a resolver in the execution context; there is no global pipeline registry.
Mapped output preserves the parent and inserts the child result.
This is the Core mechanism behind host-managed composition. Configure SrotaX asset dependencies through Call Flow, not raw registry names.
limitations: `$subPipeline` is a Core extension, not a MongoDB stage.
